content.text: Docs updated, and lint and the note format pass. Committing, pushing and tagging `compaction-v7`.

input.command:
cd "C:/Users/shrey/desktop/Elemental_harness" && git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
List every stored transcript in each compaction checkpoint

A checkpoint's transcript line is now a list: earlier checkpoints'
transcript paths carried forward, oldest first, then the new one. After
repeated compactions the model reads one list instead of following a
chain of files. Earlier paths are read only from checkpoint messages.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log -1 --oneline; git push -q -u origin compaction-phase7 2>&1 | grep -E "✔️ typecheck|✖" | tail -1; git tag -a compaction-v7 -m "List every stored transcript in each checkpoint" && git push -q origin refs/tags/compaction-v7 2>&1 | tail -1; git ls-remote origin refs/tags/compaction-v7 refs/heads/compaction-phase7
